Title: THE LAST BUS HOME
Author: Test Writer
Draft date: 2026-01-01

INT. PLANT NURSERY - DAY

RUKHMIKA waters a row of potted plants. VASANTH's motorbike rolls up outside the gate.

VASANTH
(calling out)
Hey! You're late again.

RUKHMIKA
(not looking up)
The plants don't water themselves, Vasanth.

He parks the bike and walks toward her, brushing dust off his jacket.

INT. VASANTH ROOM - EVENING

VASANTH sits on his bed, phone in hand. He dials a number.

VASANTH
(into phone)
Hello... Rukhmika?

RUKHMIKA (O.S.)
(muffled, distant)
Who is this?

He laughs nervously and sits up straighter.

EXT. BUS STOP - EARLY MORNING

VASANTH waits at an empty bus stop, checking his watch every few seconds.

VASANTH
(to himself)
Two hours. Two hours already.

A bus finally pulls up, brakes hissing.

FADE OUT.
